info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Biotite Battery Detail-v1-spec
info.description: The Biotite Battery Detail Catalog API facilitates the creation and management of detailed catalog entries for biotite batteries. This API allows users to submit comprehensive data about new battery models, including specifications and unique features. Typical consumers include battery manufacturers and cataloging systems aiming to maintain an up-to-date inventory. The API supports seamless integration into their workflows, enhancing product visibility and accessibility in the marketplace.

post.summary: Create a new battery detail entry for Biotite.
post.description: This endpoint allows you to create a new entry for battery details specifically associated with Biotite. Ensure that you provide all required fields for a successful submission.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to provide the necessary data for creating or updating the details of a biotite battery. It expects a JSON payload that conforms to the defined schema.

200.description: Request completed successfully, returning the requested battery details.
